optimization_method: GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) via TRL library

key_files.purpose: Main iterative attack loop driver; manages query budgets, checkpointing, iteration control
key_files.reuse_notes: Loop structure (candidate->evaluate->update->checkpoint) is analogous to our offline optimizer; direct execution requires AgentDojo

key_files.purpose: TRLSuffixLearner class; implements GRPO training loop using TRL GRPOTrainer
key_files.reuse_notes: Requires AgentDojo + live LLM API + GPU. Cannot run without full infrastructure.
rank_normalize_rewards() is directly borrowed in autoinject_offline_optimizer.py. Pure numpy, no heavy dependencies.

key_files.purpose: GPT-based comparative reward computation for suffix quality
key_files.reuse_notes: Requires OpenAI API. Not safe to use at this stage — would expose content to external service.

key_files.purpose: SuffixEvaluator class; evaluates suffix quality in AgentDojo benchmark
key_files.reuse_notes: Domain-specific to AgentDojo; not applicable to reasoning-model hijacking.

key_files.purpose: Random suffix mutation baseline for comparison against GRPO
key_files.reuse_notes: Conceptually maps to our always_A/D/F fixed baselines. Random selection principle is portable.

key_files.purpose: Factory for instantiating learner types (NoOp, Random, TRL-suffix)
key_files.reuse_notes: Factory pattern is useful; actual learner types are not directly portable.

key_files.purpose: Logging and statistics utilities for reward tracking
key_files.reuse_notes: Pattern is reusable; our optimization trace JSONL follows the same design.

key_files.purpose: AgentDojo benchmark suite (banking, Slack, travel, workspace tasks)
key_files.reuse_notes: Completely different domain. Not applicable to reasoning-model hijacking.

reward_signal.primary: Binary 0/1 from AgentDojo evaluator (did agent execute injected goal?)
reward_signal.secondary: GPT-4 comparative feedback (soft signal; requires OpenAI API)
reward_signal.normalization: rank_normalize_rewards: converts raw rewards to [-1, 1] range

action_space.autoinject: Continuous token sequence (up to 20 tokens appended as suffix)
action_space.our_analogue: Discrete structural wrapper choice: A / D / F / E conditions

candidate_generation.autoinject: GRPO policy model generates 8 suffix candidates per training step
candidate_generation.our_analogue: Fixed pool of existing Stage 4.7/4.8 cells; selection not generation

reasons_not_safe: GRPO training would optimize a model to generate harmful content more effectively
GPT feedback requires OpenAI API and would expose harmful content externally
AgentDojo requires live LLM API calls with adversarial injection goals
Any online generation must wait for explicit Mahmood approval

safe_integration_path.step1_this_poc: Offline replay: treat existing A/D/F/E cells as fixed candidate pool; apply AutoInject-style reward scoring and greedy selection; borrow rank_normalize_rewards
safe_integration_path.step2_requires_approval: Constrained online run: action = structural wrapper choice; generation = running Qwen3-14B on existing research prompts; reward = sr_success
safe_integration_path.step3_requires_safety_review: Extend action space to structural variations within conditions
